revisions.purpose: Release0.3.23: Tc through the years gains 20 more classic superconductors (V3Si, SrTiO3, PbMo6S8, BaPb1-xBixO3, (TMTSF)2PF6, UBe13, UPt3, Ba0.6K0.4BiO3, kappa-(BEDT-TTF)2Cu(NCS)2, Nd1.85Ce0.15CuO4, K3C60, Cs-Rb-C60, UGe2, CeCoIn5, PuCoGa5, boron-doped diamond, CaC6, Ba0.6K0.4Fe2As2, the FeSe monolayer and CaH6), each with a Crossref-checked DOI, so the chart holds 48 entries; the temperature axis becomes logarithmic because Tc now spans 0.3 K to 298 K, with liquid-helium, liquid-nitrogen and room-temperature reference lines; the chart plays year by year with a play, pause, replay and year slider, a sweep line and a readout of how many are shown and the ambient-pressure record so far; the legend filters families; each dot opens a detail panel with the material's structure animation, its note and a link to the reporting paper; six new labelled schematics (perovskite, Chevrel cluster, molecular stacks, fulleride, intercalated graphite, boron-doped diamond) join the existing ones, each with alt text saying what is not shown; V3Si joins the ambient-pressure record staircase; models, candidate lists and results are unchanged
